case.summary: Customer C02354 reported an unauthorized $39.08 card-present transaction on card C02354-K2, flagged for out-of-region use. The purchase occurred in billing region 126, inconsistent with the card’s typical in-person region 325. Match flags and customer denial support fraud suspicion. Similar cases (CC-3267, CC-3259) involved confirmed fraudulent card-present transactions in unrelated billing regions. The card was blocked, and no further evidence was requested before closure.
